subject: How to customize shape in scale_shape

messages.author: 725a19a4878ce2ea
messages.subject: How to customize shape in scale_shape
parts:
Dear list users,

I would like to make a plot of the predicted values (preds) versus the observed  (obs). I also want to mark the points as "+" if a disease status (di) is TRUE, but "-" if id is FALSE.
Here is the example code.

set.seed(1000)
dat <- data.frame( preds= runif(20), obs = runif(20),
     di = sample(c("FALSE", "TRUE"),20,TRUE))
>dat
  > dat
        preds        obs    di
1  0.32787871 0.16294456  TRUE
2  0.75884649 0.80494934  TRUE
3  0.11393640 0.28962222 FALSE
4  0.69075515 0.07177347  TRUE
5  0.51640240 0.54830544  TRUE
6  0.06773796 0.67655327  TRUE
7  0.73871486 0.45189608  TRUE
8  0.58353505 0.82412502  TRUE
9  0.21577140 0.09076793 FALSE
10 0.25612240 0.12221227  TRUE
11 0.34993746 0.56751754  TRUE
12 0.75546158 0.04970992  TRUE
13 0.31708425 0.56162037 FALSE
14 0.86581282 0.96617891  TRUE
15 0.76416075 0.50994534  TRUE
16 0.07288487 0.70093692  TRUE
17 0.49261774 0.02034940  TRUE
18 0.63516203 0.78356903  TRUE
19 0.08485787 0.58439662  TRUE
20 0.58392103 0.31729282 FALSE
qplot(preds,obs,data = dat,shape=di)

How can I change the default shapes (i.e. diamond and triangle) into "-" and "+" ? Thanks.

Changhong

messages.author: 969bc1db85a35ba3
messages.subject: Re: How to customize shape in scale_shape
parts:
how about...

p <- qplot(preds, obs, data = dat, shape = di)
p + scale_shape_manual(name = "disease status", values = c("+", "-"),
labels = c("positive", "negative"))

hope that helps

Gary
